title: 第10课 · 数学比历史难多了
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 10 — 数学比历史难多了 · Maths is much harder than history

data.topic: 课上要点 · Class notes (3 Oct 2026)

items.zh: 总览 · What this class was about (3 Oct 2026)
items.en: We practised 向某人学… (learning something from someone), read Confucius' 三人行，必有我师焉, then continued Lesson 10: approximate numbers (一两、三四、七八、二三十), 比 comparisons with 起得早/晚 and 来得多/少, then discussed Chinese–Dutch cultural differences. After the break: comparing prices, 这么/那么 with game time, the multiplication table, experiences with 过, 想/打算/计划, being early or late (早到/迟到/准点), the 不 tone change while reading Text 3, and measure words for bikes and houses. Each topic below has a short explanation followed by example sentences. The practice tabs (Practice …, Extra Words, Sayings, Culture) contain the same material for flashcards and quiz.

items.zh: 1 · 向 + person + 学 + verb + object
items.en: 'To learn something from someone.' 向 marks the person you learn from. The thing you learn needs its own verb: not 学篮球 but 学打篮球, not 学自行车 but 学骑自行车 (ride) or 学修理自行车 (repair). 做饭/做菜 is everyday cooking; 烹饪 is the more formal word.
see: 练习 · Practice (向…学…  Learn X from Y)

items.py: Wǒ xiàng péngyou xué dǎ lánqiú.
items.en: I learn to play basketball from my friend.

items.zh: 我向爸爸学修理自行车。
items.py: Wǒ xiàng bàba xué xiūlǐ zìxíngchē.
items.en: I learn to repair bicycles from my dad.
I learn to cook from my mum.
A sentence must also make sense. 我向妈妈学荷兰语 sounds odd if you already speak Dutch as well as she does — say 我小时候… instead. And 妈妈 alone means your own mum; for someone else's, say whose: 他的妈妈.
see: 练习 · Practice (向…学…  Learn X from Y)

items.zh: 我小时候向妈妈学荷兰语。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou xiàng māma xué Hélányǔ.
items.en: As a child I learned Dutch from my mum.

items.py: Wǒ xiàng tā de māma xué zuòfàn.
items.en: I learn to cook from his mum.

Confucius: among any three people, there is one I can learn from. Follow their good points (择其善者而从之); when you see their faults, check whether you have them too and correct yourself (其不善者而改之). Attitude: 谦虚 + 观察 + 学习 — humble, observe, learn.
see: 格言 · Sayings (三人行，必有我师焉)

items.py: Sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī yān.
items.en: When three people walk together, one of them can be my teacher.

items.zh: 择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之。
items.py: Zé qí shàn zhě ér cóng zhī, qí bù shàn zhě ér gǎi zhī.
items.en: Follow their good points; correct in yourself what is bad in them.

A related saying used when someone (e.g. a parent) criticises you: if it's true, correct it; if it isn't, don't argue — take it as a reminder to do even better. A traditional attitude of respect for elders.
see: 格言 · Sayings (三人行，必有我师焉)

items.py: Yǒu zé gǎi zhī, wú zé jiā miǎn.
items.en: If you have the fault, correct it; if not, take it as encouragement.

Two neighbouring numbers together give an estimate: 一两 (1–2), 三四 (3–4), 七八 (7–8), 二三十 (20–30), 四五十 (40–50). 三四杯 means 'three or four', never 34. The exact number doesn't matter — it gives a feeling: 七八分钟 by bike is close; 二三十分钟 by car is a comfortable commute; 四五十分钟 can easily become an hour.
see: 练习 · Practice (概数：二三十分钟 Approximate numbers)
语法 · Grammar (概数：一两、三四、七八)

items.zh: 我每天学习一两个小时汉语。
items.py: Wǒ měi tiān xuéxí yī-liǎng ge xiǎoshí Hànyǔ.
items.en: I study Chinese one or two hours a day.

items.zh: 你都喝了三四杯咖啡了，别再喝了！
items.py: Nǐ dōu hēle sān-sì bēi kāfēi le, bié zài hē le!
items.en: You've already had three or four coffees — stop!

items.zh: 骑车七八分钟，走路大概要二十分钟。
items.py: Qí chē qī-bā fēnzhōng, zǒulù dàgài yào èrshí fēnzhōng.
items.en: Seven or eight minutes by bike, about twenty on foot.

items.zh: 开车二三十分钟，可以接受。
items.py: Kāi chē èr-sānshí fēnzhōng, kěyǐ jiēshòu.
items.en: Twenty or thirty minutes' drive is acceptable.

items.zh: 附近有三四个车站，有很多选择。
items.py: Fùjìn yǒu sān-sì ge chēzhàn, yǒu hěn duō xuǎnzé.
items.en: Three or four stations nearby — lots of choice.

items.zh: 4 · 谁起得早？ Comparing with 比
items.en: Ask: A和B谁 + verb + 得 + adj? Answer with A比B + verb + 得 + adj, or say how much: A比B + 早起/晚起 + duration. Both directions work: if I get up 2 hours earlier, she gets up 2 hours later. Keep durations realistic (半个小时, 四十分钟).
see: 练习 · Practice (谁起得早？ Who gets up earlier?)

items.py: Nǐ hé māma shéi qǐ de zǎo?
items.en: Who gets up earlier, you or your mum?

items.py: Wǒ bǐ tā zǎo qǐ bàn ge xiǎoshí.
items.en: I get up half an hour earlier than her.

items.py: Tā bǐ wǒ wǎn qǐ bàn ge xiǎoshí.
items.en: She gets up half an hour later than me.
Comparing how many came: use 多 (more) and 少 (fewer). Not 小 — 小 means small (size). Today 9 students came, last Saturday 6.
see: 练习 · Practice (多少 & 比 Class numbers)

items.zh: 今天我们班来了九个学生。
items.py: Jīntiān wǒmen bān lái le jiǔ ge xuésheng.
items.en: Nine students came to our class today.

items.zh: 上个星期六比今天来得少。
items.py: Shàng ge xīngqīliù bǐ jīntiān lái de shǎo.
items.en: Fewer came last Saturday than today.

items.zh: 今天比上个星期六来得多。
items.py: Jīntiān bǐ shàng ge xīngqīliù lái de duō.
items.en: More came today than last Saturday.

items.zh: 6 · 中荷文化 · China vs the Netherlands
items.en: Chinese like 早睡早起 and meet early; Dutch weekend plans often start after twelve. Chinese put the time first in a sentence (今天我们…), Dutch often later. In the Netherlands calling someone 胖 is taboo. Chinese rarely describe people by hair colour — almost everyone has black hair — while Dutch descriptions (even police ones) often do: 黑头发、金头发、棕色头发.
see: 文化 · Culture (中荷差异 China vs Netherlands)

items.py: Zhōngguórén xǐhuan zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ.
items.en: Chinese people like to go to bed early and get up early.

items.zh: 中国人大多是黑头发，所以很少说头发的颜色。
items.py: Zhōngguórén dàduō shì hēi tóufa, suǒyǐ hěn shǎo shuō tóufa de yánsè.
items.en: Most Chinese have black hair, so hair colour is rarely mentioned.

Because Chinese people nearly all have black, straight hair, hair and eye colour don't help to identify someone in China. In the Netherlands they do: you describe height, hair colour, eye colour and curly or straight hair.
see: 文化 · Culture (中荷差异 China vs Netherlands)

items.zh: 他很高，头发是棕色的，眼睛是蓝色的。
items.py: Tā hěn gāo, tóufa shì zōngsè de, yǎnjing shì lánsè de.
items.en: He's tall, with brown hair and blue eyes.

items.py: Tā shì juǎnfà, bú shì zhífà.
items.en: She has curly hair, not straight hair.

Expensive or cheap only means something when you compare. A classmate from Vietnam compared Ho Chi Minh City with Shenzhen. Also: prices rise everywhere (通货膨胀, inflation), but Chinese manufactured goods are cheap now — a cup costs 18 yuan in China and over 20 euros in the Netherlands.

items.zh: 胡志明市比深圳便宜一些。
items.py: Húzhìmíng Shì bǐ Shēnzhèn piányi yìxiē.
items.en: Ho Chi Minh City is a bit cheaper than Shenzhen.

items.zh: 胡志明市今年比去年贵很多。
items.py: Húzhìmíng Shì jīnnián bǐ qùnián guì hěn duō.
items.en: Ho Chi Minh City is much more expensive this year than last year.
A parent asks 你们今天玩儿了多长时间游戏？ If it was long: 怎么玩儿了这么长时间？ (why so long?). The child answers with 没有那么长 (not that long). 这么 = 'so' about something here/now, 那么 = 'so' about something there/then.
see: 练习 · Practice (这么 / 那么 Game time)

items.zh: 你们今天玩儿了多长时间游戏？
items.py: Nǐmen jīntiān wánr le duō cháng shíjiān yóuxì?
items.en: How long did you play games today?

items.zh: 怎么玩儿了这么长时间？
items.py: Zěnme wánr le zhème cháng shíjiān?
items.en: How come you played for so long?

items.zh: 昨天只玩儿了十五分钟，今天没有那么长。
items.py: Zuótiān zhǐ wánr le shíwǔ fēnzhōng, jīntiān méiyǒu nàme cháng.
items.en: Yesterday I only played fifteen minutes; today wasn't that long.

items.py: Wǒ hǎo lèi, wǒ zhème lèi!
items.en: I'm so tired!

items.zh: 10 · 乘法口诀 · The multiplication table
items.en: Chinese children recite the times table as short rhymes, often before they can write: 一一得一, 二二得四, 三三得九, 二五一十, 四五二十, 八八六十四. 得 (dé) is used when the answer is a single digit.
see: 练习 · Practice (乘法口诀 Times table)

items.py: Sān sān dé jiǔ, bā bā liùshísì.
items.en: Three threes are nine, eight eights are sixty-four.

Verb + 过 = you have done it (at least once) before. 我参加比赛 is a plan or a fact; 我参加过比赛 = I have taken part in a competition before. Negative: 没(有) + verb + 过. 过 also means 'past/over': 我走过小江 = I walk past Xiao Jiang. Measure word for concerts: 场 (一场音乐会). Chinese say 听京剧 (listen to Beijing opera), not 看.

items.py: Wǒ pá guo liǎng-sān cì shān.
items.en: I've climbed mountains two or three times.
I've taken part in a marathon.

items.zh: 我今年听过五场音乐会。
items.py: Wǒ jīnnián tīng guo wǔ chǎng yīnyuèhuì.
items.en: I've been to five concerts this year.

items.py: Wǒ jīnnián méi tīng guo yīnyuèhuì.
items.en: I haven't been to a concert this year.

items.py: Nǐ qù guo Zhōngguó ma? — Qù guo.
items.en: Have you been to China? — Yes, I have.

items.zh: 那家越南餐馆我去过了。
items.py: Nà jiā Yuènán cānguǎn wǒ qù guo le.
items.en: I've already been to that Vietnamese restaurant.
Have you ever eaten snails?
Three steps from idea to plan. 想 = I'd like to (an idea, informal). 打算 = I intend to (the idea is getting clear). 计划 = I plan to (concrete: you've bought running shoes, have a schedule or a coach).
see: 练习 · Practice (想 / 打算 / 计划)

items.en: I'd like to run a marathon.
I intend to run a marathon next year.

items.zh: 我计划十一月去听音乐会。
items.py: Wǒ jìhuà shíyī yuè qù tīng yīnyuèhuì.
items.en: I plan to go to a concert in November.

items.zh: 13 · 早到 · 迟到 · 准点到
items.en: 早到 = arrive early, 迟到 = arrive late, 准点到 = arrive exactly on time. 准 = accurate (这个手表很准); 对一下表 = synchronise watches. Dutch people are very punctual — even for children's birthday parties.
see: 练习 · Practice (早到 / 迟到 / 准点)

items.py: Jīntiān Xiǎobā hé John zǎo dào le.
items.en: Today Xiaoba and John came early.

items.zh: 我上课迟到过一次，因为火车晚点了。
items.py: Wǒ shàngkè chídào guo yí cì, yīnwèi huǒchē wǎndiǎn le.
items.en: I've been late for class once, because the train was delayed.
Dutch people are very punctual.
不 is normally 4th tone (bù), but before another 4th tone it becomes 2nd tone: 不是 búshì, 不要 búyào. Try both — the changed one feels more comfortable.
see: 课文3 · 3. 在休息室 — In the lounge

items.py: Nǐ bú shì yǒu yí liàng ma?
items.en: Don't you have one already?

items.zh: 那辆太旧了，要换一辆，很便宜，两三百块钱。
items.py: Nà liàng tài jiù le, yào huàn yí liàng, hěn piányi, liǎng-sānbǎi kuài qián.
items.en: That one is too old, I need a new one — it's cheap, two or three hundred yuan.

items.zh: 15 · Measure words: 辆 · 栋 · 套
items.en: Without a number it's general: 我想买车 / 买房子 (I'd like to buy a car / property). With a number you need the measure word: 一辆自行车, 一辆车; a house is 一栋房子, an apartment 一套公寓. The teacher's tip: a house is an asset (资产), a car loses value right away.
see: 练习 · Practice (量词 辆 / 栋 / 套)

items.py: Wǒ hái dǎsuàn mǎi liàng zìxíngchē.
items.en: I'm also planning to buy a bike.

items.zh: 我想在鹿特丹买一套公寓。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng zài Lùtèdān mǎi yí tào gōngyù.
items.en: I want to buy an apartment in Rotterdam.
He has two houses.

1) Write 10 sentences with 我向…学…  2) 5 sentences with 一两/三四/七八/二三十 about commuting, study time, coffee, stations.  3) 5 pairs of 比 sentences in both directions (早起/晚起).  4) Learn 三人行，必有我师焉 by heart.  5) Practise 早到/迟到 and verb + 过: write 5 things you have (or haven't) done.  6) Read Text 3 aloud, watching the tone of 不.

items.zh: 朋友：大山，你和马可谁个子高？
items.py: Péngyou: Dàshān, nǐ hé Mǎkě shéi gèzi gāo?
items.en: Friend: Dashan, who is taller, you or Mark?

items.zh: 大山：马可比我高，我比马可矮一点儿。
items.py: Dàshān: Mǎkě bǐ wǒ gāo, wǒ bǐ Mǎkě ǎi yīdiǎnr.
items.en: Dashan: Mark is taller than me; I'm a little shorter than Mark.
Friend: Then who is older?

items.py: Dàshān: Wǒ bǐ Mǎkě dà liǎng suì.
items.en: Dashan: I'm two years older than Mark.

items.zh: 朋友：你们谁的汉语说得更好？
items.py: Péngyou: Nǐmen shéi de Hànyǔ shuō de gèng hǎo?
items.en: Friend: Which of you speaks Chinese better?

items.zh: 大山：马可比我说得好一些，我的汉语没有他好。
items.py: Dàshān: Mǎkě bǐ wǒ shuō de hǎo yīxiē, wǒ de Hànyǔ méiyǒu tā hǎo.
items.en: Dashan: Mark speaks a bit better than me; my Chinese isn't as good as his.

items.zh: 小明：我喜欢历史课、体育课，不喜欢数学课。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ xǐhuan lìshǐ kè, tǐyù kè, bù xǐhuan shùxué kè.
items.en: Xiaoming: I like history and P.E. classes, but I don't like maths.

items.zh: 同学：为什么？数学也很有意思啊。
items.py: Tóngxué: Wèi shénme? Shùxué yě hěn yǒu yìsi a.
items.en: Classmate: Why? Maths is interesting too.

items.zh: 小明：我觉得数学比历史难多了，我听不懂。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ juéde shùxué bǐ lìshǐ nán duō le, wǒ tīng bu dǒng.
items.en: Xiaoming: I think maths is much harder than history; I can't understand it.

items.zh: 同学：别担心，我可以帮你。
items.py: Tóngxué: Bié dān xīn, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
items.en: Classmate: Don't worry, I can help you.

items.zh: 小明：好啊，我们每天学多长时间？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Hǎo a, wǒmen měi tiān xué duō cháng shíjiān?
items.en: Xiaoming: Great, how long shall we study each day?
Classmate: One or two hours, I guess.

items.en: Xiaoli: Yes, didn't you know? I moved last month. It's only a twenty-minute walk.
Colleague: That's very convenient.

items.zh: 大山：这两个地方的房子一样吗？
items.py: Dàshān: Zhè liǎng ge dìfang de fángzi yīyàng ma?
items.en: Dashan: Are the apartments in these two places the same?

items.zh: 中介：不一样。您看，学校外边的房子比学校里边的大一些。
items.py: Zhōngjiè: Bù yīyàng. Nín kàn, xuéxiào wàibian de fángzi bǐ xuéxiào lǐbian de dà yīxiē.

items.zh: 中介：学校里边的没有学校外边的那么安静。
items.py: Zhōngjiè: Xuéxiào lǐbian de méiyǒu xuéxiào wàibian de nàme ānjìng.
items.en: Agent: The one inside the school isn't as quiet as the one outside.
Dashan: Which one is a bit more convenient?

items.zh: 中介：学校里边比学校外边方便，附近有三四个车站。
items.py: Zhōngjiè: Xuéxiào lǐbian bǐ xuéxiào wàibian fāngbiàn, fùjìn yǒu sān-sì ge chēzhàn.

data.topic: 文化 · Culture (中荷差异 China vs Netherlands)

items.zh: 在荷兰，说别人胖不太礼貌。
items.py: Zài Hélán, shuō biérén pàng bù tài lǐmào.
items.en: In the Netherlands, calling someone fat is not very polite.

items.zh: 中国人大多是黑头发，所以很少说头发的颜色。
items.py: Zhōngguórén dàduō shì hēi tóufa, suǒyǐ hěn shǎo shuō tóufa de yánsè.
items.en: Most Chinese have black hair, so hair colour is rarely mentioned.

items.py: Zhōngguórén xǐhuan zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ.
items.en: Chinese people like to go to bed early and get up early.

items.zh: 荷兰人周末常常十二点以后才见面。
items.py: Hélánrén zhōumò chángcháng shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu cái jiànmiàn.
items.en: Dutch people often only meet after twelve at weekends.

items.zh: 中国人喜欢把时间放在句子前面：今天我们去学校。
items.py: Zhōngguórén xǐhuan bǎ shíjiān fàng zài jùzi qiánmiàn: jīntiān wǒmen qù xuéxiào.
items.en: Chinese like to put the time at the front: 'Today we go to school.'

items.zh: 荷兰人描述别人时常常说头发的颜色：黑头发、金头发、棕色头发。
items.py: Hélánrén miáoshù biérén shí chángcháng shuō tóufa de yánsè: hēi tóufa, jīn tóufa, zōngsè tóufa.
items.en: Dutch people often mention hair colour when describing someone: black, blond, brown.

items.zh: 说别人的妈妈，要说清楚是谁的妈妈。
items.py: Shuō biérén de māma, yào shuō qīngchu shì shéi de māma.
items.en: When you mean someone else's mum, say clearly whose mum.

items.zh: 在荷兰，描述一个人常常说眼睛的颜色和卷发、直发。
items.py: Zài Hélán, miáoshù yí ge rén chángcháng shuō yǎnjing de yánsè hé juǎnfà, zhífà.
items.en: In the Netherlands you often describe someone by eye colour and curly or straight hair.

items.zh: 中国孩子很小就背乘法口诀。
items.py: Zhōngguó háizi hěn xiǎo jiù bèi chéngfǎ kǒujué.
items.en: Chinese children learn the times table rhyme by heart at a very young age.

items.zh: 荷兰人连孩子的生日聚会都很准点。
items.py: Hélánrén lián háizi de shēngrì jùhuì dōu hěn zhǔndiǎn.
items.en: Dutch people are punctual even for children's birthday parties.
